population: Cleaned listings with at least one review in the last 12 months. A row with no reviews in that window is unobserved, not zero nights.
note: Frozen before any occupancy feature set or model was fit. Listing ids only. The split uses coordinates and seed 31, not the nights label and not the price. Seed 31 was not searched. It is not 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 11, 23, or 42.
